# halloween_party Development Guidelines

Auto-generated from all feature plans. Last updated: 2025-10-22

## Constitutional Requirements

**CRITICAL**: All development MUST comply with the Halloween Party Constitution (`.specify/memory/constitution.md`):
- Code Quality First: Automated quality gates mandatory
- UX Consistency: Design system + WCAG 2.1 AA compliance required
- Performance Standards: <3s page loads, <500ms API responses
- Test-Driven Development: >80% coverage, tests-first approach
- Observability & Monitoring: Structured logging, metrics, error tracking
